title: Save the active document view as a bitmap
summary: Gets the active document view's window handle and bounds from the SDK and copies its on-screen pixels into a BMP file with GDI BitBlt.
phrasings: capture a schematic view to an image
get the window handle of a document view
export what the editor shows as BMP

commands.name: CreateImages
commands.description: Save the current document view as a bitmap
commands.params: Out=<file or folder> (optional, default: temp folder, file DocumentViewBitmap.bmp)
